definition_zh: 安全地；稳妥地；安然无恙地
definition_en: in a way that is free from danger; without being harmed; in a reliable way
core_image: 一个人稳稳地走过湿滑的路面，没有摔倒
scene: 飞机安全着陆。The plane landed safely.
sceneCN: 这里 safely 是「安全地」（第 1 个义项）；句意：飞机安全着陆。

senses.title: Without danger
senses.definition: in a way that avoids danger or harm
senses.definitionCN: 以避免危险或伤害的方式
senses.example: The children crossed the road safely.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们安全地过了马路。
senses.why: The core sense is acting free from danger.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是以免于危险的方式行动。

senses.title: In a reliable way
senses.definition: in a careful and reliable way
senses.definitionCN: 以谨慎可靠的方式
senses.example: The files are safely locked away.
senses.exampleCN: 文件被稳妥地锁了起来。
senses.why: Freedom from danger becomes dependability.
senses.whyCN: 免于危险变成可靠稳妥。

senses.title: Without being harmed
senses.definition: without being hurt or damaged
senses.definitionCN: 没有受到伤害或损坏
senses.example: The missing dog returned safely.
senses.exampleCN: 走失的狗安然无恙地回来了。
senses.why: The result of protection is coming back unharmed.
senses.whyCN: 保护的结果是平安归来。

intro.en: Safely is safe plus the adverb ending -ly; safe comes from Latin salvus.
intro.cn: safely 由 safe 加副词词尾 -ly 构成，safe 源自拉丁语 salvus。

items.en: Salvus means uninjured and healthy.
items.cn: salvus 意为未受伤的、健康的。

items.en: Sauf carries the sense of being unharmed.
items.cn: sauf 保留「未受伤害」的含义。

items.en: Safe becomes the common word for security.
items.cn: 中古英语中 safe 成为表示安全的常用词。

items.en: The ending -ly turns safe into a manner word.
items.cn: 词尾 -ly 把 safe 变成方式副词。

items.en: Safely describes how an action is done.
items.cn: 现代英语中 safely 描述动作进行的方式。

note.en: Safely means without danger; safely is an adverb, safety a noun.
note.cn: safely 是安全地，safety 则是名词「安全」。

entries.definition: in a quiet or gentle way
in a safe and firmly fixed way
in a strong and healthy way

normalIntro.en: Safely tells how someone does something without being harmed.
normalIntro.cn: safely 说明某人如何做事而不受伤害。

normal.en: Please drive safely in the rain.
The hikers returned safely before dark.
normal.cn: 徒步者在天黑前平安返回。

normal.en: Keep your passport safely in your bag.
normal.cn: 把护照稳妥地放在包里。

normal.en: The package arrived safely.
She safely removed the hot pan.

abstract.en: Picture a child crossing a road with a guard.
abstract.cn: 想象一个孩子在协管员带领下过马路。

abstract.en: Imagine a boat reaching the shore in calm water.
abstract.cn: 想象一条船在平静水面上靠岸。

abstract.en: Think of a key turned firmly in a lock.
abstract.cn: 想象钥匙在锁里稳稳转动。

examples.en: The medicine should be stored safely.
examples.cn: 药品应安全存放。

examples.en: They arrived safely after a long flight.
examples.cn: 经过长途飞行，他们安全抵达。

examples.en: He safely carried the glass to the table.
examples.cn: 他稳稳地把玻璃杯端到桌边。

dict_mnemonic.note: 构词记忆 · 非词源
dict_mnemonic.text: safe 加副词后缀 -ly，表示「以安全的方式」，就是 safely。

root: 由 safe 加 -ly 构成，safe 源自拉丁语 salvus（未受伤的），核心义「以免于危险的方式」。

sensesIntro.en: Safely means in a way free from danger, reliably, or without being harmed.
sensesIntro.cn: safely 意为以免于危险的方式、稳妥可靠地，或安然无恙地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a steady step across a slippery road.
core.cn: 核心意象：稳稳走过湿滑路面的一步。

branches.en: The base sense is acting without danger.
branches.cn: 基础义是以免于危险的方式行动。

branches.en: Freedom from danger becomes reliability.
branches.cn: 免于危险变成可靠稳妥。

branches.en: The result is returning unharmed.
branches.cn: 结果是平安归来。

branches.en: Avoiding danger and acting reliably support each other.
branches.cn: 避开危险与可靠行动相互支持。

branches.en: A safe action often ends in an unharmed return.
branches.cn: 安全行动常常以安然返回结束。

intro.en: Safely is safe plus -ly, from the Latin salvus family.
intro.cn: safely 由 safe 加 -ly 构成，属于拉丁语 salvus 词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin salvus is the distant source of safe and safely.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 salvus 是 safe 与 safely 的远源。

items.example: The area is safe at night.

items.exampleCN: 安全是我们最关心的事。

items.example: They checked the safeness of the bridge.
items.exampleCN: 他们检查了桥梁的安全性。

items.example: This road is safer than the old one.
It is the safest route home.
items.exampleCN: 这是回家最安全的路线。

definition_zh: 安全；安全性；安全措施
definition_en: the state of being safe; the quality of not causing harm; things done to prevent danger
core_image: 一顶安全帽、一条安全带和一道护栏
scene: 乘客的安全是首要任务。Passenger safety is the first priority.
sceneCN: 这里 safety 是「安全」（第 1 个义项）；句意：乘客的安全是首要任务。

forms.label: 复数（安全装置或安全分）

senses.title: The state of being safe
senses.definition: the state of being protected from danger or harm
senses.definitionCN: 受到保护而免于危险或伤害的状态
senses.example: The safety of the passengers comes first.
senses.exampleCN: 乘客的安全是第一位的。
senses.why: The core sense is the condition of being protected.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是受到保护的状态。

senses.title: Freedom from harm
senses.definition: the quality of not causing danger or harm
senses.definitionCN: 不会造成危险或伤害的性质
senses.example: Engineers tested the safety of the bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师检测了桥梁的安全性。
senses.why: A protected state becomes a measurable quality.
senses.whyCN: 受保护的状态变成可衡量的性质。

senses.title: Safety measures
senses.definition: things done or used to prevent danger
senses.definitionCN: 为防止危险而采取或使用的措施与设备
senses.example: The factory improved its fire safety.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂改善了消防安全。
senses.why: The abstract state becomes concrete measures.
senses.whyCN: 抽象状态变成具体措施。

intro.en: Safety is safe plus the noun ending -ty, from Latin salvus and -itas.
intro.cn: safety 由 safe 加名词词尾 -ty 构成，根源是拉丁语 salvus 与 -itas。

items.en: Salvus means uninjured and healthy.
items.cn: salvus 意为未受伤的、健康的。

items.en: The ending -itas forms nouns of quality.
items.cn: 词尾 -itas 构成表示性质的名词。

items.en: Sauf carries the sense of being unharmed.
items.cn: sauf 保留「未受伤害」的含义。

items.en: Safety names the state of being safe.
items.cn: safety 指安全的状态。

items.en: Safety also means safety measures.
items.cn: 现代英语中 safety 也指安全措施。

note.en: Safety is the state; security is protection from threats.
note.cn: safety 是安全状态，security 则更强调对威胁的防护。

entries.definition: a group of people living together
a natural ability or a university department
the act of keeping someone safe
the health and safety of people

normalIntro.en: Safety is the state of being protected and the measures that keep us protected.
normalIntro.cn: safety 既是被保护的状态，也是保护我们的措施。

normal.en: Road safety is taught in every school.
normal.cn: 每所学校都教授道路安全。

normal.en: Please fasten your safety belt.
The workers demanded better safety.
normal.cn: 工人们要求更好的安全保障。

normal.en: For safety, keep the door locked.
New safety rules were introduced.

abstract.en: Picture a helmet, a belt, and a guard rail together.
abstract.cn: 想象安全帽、安全带与护栏放在一起。

abstract.en: Imagine a bridge tested until everyone trusts it.
abstract.cn: 想象一座经过检测、人人放心的桥。

abstract.en: Think of a light left on for a safe path.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏为安全照路的灯。

examples.en: Safety at work is everyone's duty.
examples.cn: 工作安全是每个人的责任。

examples.en: The new car has excellent safety records.
examples.cn: 这款新车有出色的安全记录。

examples.en: They checked the safety of the water.
examples.cn: 他们检测了水的安全性。

dict_mnemonic.text: safe 加名词后缀 -ty，表示「安全的状态」，就是 safety。

root: 由 safe 加 -ty 构成，根源是拉丁语 salvus（未受伤的），核心义「受保护的状态与保障措施」。

sensesIntro.en: Safety means the state of being safe, the quality of causing no harm, or safety measures.
sensesIntro.cn: safety 意为安全状态、不造成伤害的性质，或安全措施。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a helmet, a belt, and a guard rail.
core.cn: 核心意象：安全帽、安全带与护栏。

branches.en: The base sense is the state of being protected.
branches.cn: 基础义是受到保护的状态。

branches.en: The state becomes a measurable quality.
branches.cn: 状态变成可衡量的性质。

branches.en: The abstract state becomes concrete measures.
branches.cn: 抽象状态变成具体措施。

branches.en: Being safe and proving safety go together.
branches.cn: 处于安全与证明安全相互关联。

branches.en: Measured safety leads to better safety measures.
branches.cn: 经过衡量的安全带来更好的安全措施。

intro.en: Safety is safe plus -ty, a Latin noun ending seen in security and certainty.
intro.cn: safety 由 safe 加 -ty 构成，-ty 是见于 security、certainty 的拉丁名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin salvus and the ending -itas are the distant sources.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 salvus 与词尾 -itas 是远源。

items.exampleCN: 这台机器有两个安全装置。

items.example: They questioned the safeness of the plan.

items.example: There is no certainty of success.

definition_zh: 帆；航行；航行；轻快移动
definition_en: a large cloth that catches the wind; a journey by boat; to travel on water; to move smoothly and quickly
core_image: 一面被海风吹得鼓起来的白帆
scene: 他们黎明时起航。They set sail at dawn.
sceneCN: 这里 sail 是「航行、起航」（第 2 个义项）；句意：他们黎明时起航。

senses.title: The cloth that catches wind
senses.definition: a large piece of cloth fixed to a boat to catch the wind
senses.definitionCN: 固定在船上用来兜风的大块布
senses.example: The wind filled the sail.
senses.exampleCN: 风把帆吹得鼓起来。
senses.why: The core object is the cloth that drives a boat.
senses.whyCN: 核心物件是推动船只的布。

senses.title: A journey by boat
senses.definition: a trip on water in a boat or ship
senses.definitionCN: 乘船在水上的行程
senses.example: The sail to the island takes two hours.
senses.exampleCN: 到岛上的航程需要两小时。
senses.why: The object becomes the journey it makes possible.
senses.whyCN: 物件变成它促成的航程。

senses.title: Travel on water
senses.definition: to travel on water using wind or an engine
senses.definitionCN: 利用风力或发动机在水上行驶
senses.example: They sail along the coast every summer.
senses.exampleCN: 他们每年夏天沿海岸航行。
senses.why: The noun becomes the action of travelling.
senses.whyCN: 名词变成航行的动作。

senses.title: Move smoothly
senses.definition: to move smoothly and confidently
senses.definitionCN: 平稳而自信地移动
senses.example: She sailed through the exam.
senses.exampleCN: 她轻松通过了考试。
senses.why: Smooth travel becomes smooth success.
senses.whyCN: 平稳航行变成顺利成功。

intro.en: Sail comes from Old English segl, a word shared across Germanic languages.
intro.cn: sail 源自古英语 segl，这个词在日耳曼语中广泛存在。

items.en: Segl names the cloth that catches wind.
items.cn: segl 指兜风的布。

items.en: The word is related to cutting cloth.
items.cn: 这个词与裁剪布匹有关。

items.en: Sail names both the cloth and the journey.
items.cn: 中古英语中 sail 兼指帆与航程。

items.en: Sail becomes a verb for travelling on water.
items.cn: sail 成为表示水上航行的动词。

items.en: Sail also means to move smoothly.
items.cn: 现代英语中 sail 也指轻快移动。

note.en: Sail is the cloth or travel; sale is selling.
note.cn: sail 是帆或航行，sale 则是销售，两者同音。

entries.definition: the earth in which plants grow
a small slow animal with a shell

normalIntro.en: Sail is the cloth, the journey, and the smooth movement of a boat.
normalIntro.cn: sail 既指帆，也指航程与船只的平稳移动。

normal.en: The sail was torn by the strong wind.
They set sail for the islands.
We sail along the river in summer.
The ship sailed into the harbour.
She sailed through the interview.

abstract.en: Picture a white sail filled by a strong wind.
abstract.cn: 想象一张被强风鼓满的白帆。

abstract.en: Imagine a boat cutting smoothly through blue water.
abstract.cn: 想象小船平稳地划过蓝色水面。

abstract.en: Think of a flag-like cloth pulling a ship forward.
abstract.cn: 想象一块旗子般的布牵引船只前进。

examples.en: The boat sailed around the island.
examples.cn: 小船绕岛航行。

examples.en: We set sail before the sun rose.
examples.cn: 我们在日出前起航。

examples.en: The team sailed through the first round.
examples.cn: 这支队伍轻松通过了第一轮。

root: 源自古英语 segl（帆），核心义「兜风推动船只的布」，引申为航行与平稳移动。

sensesIntro.en: Sail means the cloth that catches wind, a boat journey, to travel on water, or to move smoothly.
sensesIntro.cn: sail 意为兜风的帆、乘船航程、在水上航行，或平稳移动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a white sail filled by the wind.
core.cn: 核心意象：被海风鼓满的白帆。

branches.en: The base object is the cloth that catches wind.
branches.cn: 基础物件是兜风的布。

branches.en: The object becomes the journey it enables.

branches.en: The noun becomes the action of travelling.
branches.cn: 名词变成航行的动作。

branches.en: Smooth travel becomes smooth success.
branches.cn: 平稳航行变成顺利成功。

branches.en: The sail and the act of sailing belong together.
branches.cn: 帆与航行行为紧密相连。

intro.en: Sail is a native English word that forms sailor, sailing, and sailboat.
intro.cn: sail 是英语本族词，构成 sailor、sailing 与 sailboat。

latinIntro.en: Sail has no Latin root; it comes from Old English segl.
latinIntro.cn: sail 没有拉丁词根，它来自古英语 segl。

more than one sail or travels by boat
the act or sport of using a sail

definition_zh: 水手；海员；帆船运动员
definition_en: a person who works on a ship; a person who sails boats for sport
core_image: 一个站在甲板上、手里拉着缆绳的水手
scene: 老水手讲起了海上的故事。The old sailor told stories of the sea.
sceneCN: 这里 sailor 是「水手、海员」（第 1 个义项）；句意：老水手讲起了海上的故事。

senses.title: A ship worker
senses.definition: a person who works on a ship or boat
senses.definitionCN: 在轮船或小船上工作的人
senses.example: The sailor tied the ropes tightly.
senses.exampleCN: 水手把绳子系得很紧。
senses.why: The core sense is a person who works with sails and ships.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是与帆和船一起工作的人。

senses.title: A sailing sportsperson
senses.definition: a person who sails boats for sport
senses.definitionCN: 为运动而驾驶帆船的人
senses.example: She is a skilled sailor in small boats.
senses.exampleCN: 她是一名熟练的小帆船运动员。
senses.why: Work on ships becomes sport on water.
senses.whyCN: 船上的工作变成水上运动。

senses.title: An experienced voyager
senses.definition: a person who is experienced in travelling by sea
senses.definitionCN: 有丰富海上旅行经验的人
senses.example: The old sailor knew every star.
senses.exampleCN: 这位老航海者认识每一颗星。
senses.why: Skill with boats becomes knowledge of the sea.
senses.whyCN: 驾船技能变成对海洋的了解。

intro.en: Sailor is sail plus the person ending -or, meaning one who sails.
intro.cn: sailor 由 sail 加表示人的词尾 -or 构成，意为「驾船的人」。

items.en: Segl names the cloth that catches wind.
items.cn: segl 指兜风的布。

items.en: The ending -or marks a person who does something.
items.cn: 词尾 -or 标记从事某事的人。

items.en: Sailor names a person who sails.
items.cn: sailor 指驾船航行的人。

items.en: Sailor also names a sailing sportsperson.

items.en: Sail, sailing, and sailboat share the same base.
items.cn: sail、sailing 与 sailboat 共享同一词基。

note.en: Sailor works on a ship; tailor makes clothes.
note.cn: sailor 是在船上工作的人，tailor 则是裁缝。

entries.definition: a man who is not married
a sailor, especially in the navy
the people who work on a ship

normalIntro.cn: sailor 是以航行作为工作或运动的人。

normal.en: The sailor climbed the mast.
Sailors learn to tie many knots.
normal.cn: 水手要学会打很多种结。

normal.en: The young sailor missed his family.
She became a sailor at eighteen.
The sailor watched the horizon.

abstract.cn: 想象甲板上拉绳子的身影。

abstract.en: Imagine a face weathered by salt and wind.
abstract.cn: 想象一张被盐和风磨砺的脸。

abstract.en: Think of a person who reads the sea like a map.
abstract.cn: 想象一个把大海当地图来读的人。

examples.en: The sailor knew the stars well.

dict_mnemonic.note: 构词记忆 · 非词源
dict_mnemonic.text: sail 加表示人的后缀 -or：驾船航行的人，就是 sailor（水手）。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a figure on deck holding a rope.

branches.en: The base sense is a person who works on ships.

branches.en: Ship work becomes water sport.

branches.en: Working on ships and knowing the sea go together.

intro.en: Sailor is sail plus -or, and it sits at the center of the sail word family.

definition_zh: 圣人；圣徒；道德高尚的人
definition_en: a very holy person honored by a religion; a very kind and patient person; a title before a holy name
core_image: 教堂彩窗上带光环的圣徒画像

senses.title: A holy person
senses.definition: a very holy person honored by a religion
senses.definitionCN: 受宗教敬奉的非常神圣的人
senses.example: The church was built for a local saint.
senses.exampleCN: 这座教堂是为一位当地圣徒修建的。

senses.whyCN: 核心义是被视为神圣的人。

senses.title: A very kind person
senses.definition: a very kind, patient, and good person
senses.definitionCN: 非常善良、耐心且高尚的人

definition_zh: 缘故；理由；目的；日本清酒

definition_zh: 相同的；同一的；不变的
definition_en: exactly alike or not different; the very one already mentioned or known; unchanged from before
core_image: 两件物品并排放置，看不出任何差别
scene: 我们穿同样的鞋。We wear the same shoes.
sceneCN: 这里 same 是「相同的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：我们穿同样的鞋。

forms.label: 无比较级与最高级（本身已表相同）

senses.title: Exactly alike
senses.definition: exactly alike in kind, amount, or quality
senses.definitionCN: 在种类、数量或质量上完全一样
senses.example: We chose the same colour.
senses.exampleCN: 我们选了同样的颜色。
senses.why: The base sense is simple equality between things.
senses.whyCN: 基础义就是事物之间的简单相等。

senses.title: The very one
senses.definition: the particular one already mentioned, not a different one
senses.definitionCN: 已经提到的那个特定的，而不是另一个
senses.example: This is the same man I saw yesterday.
senses.exampleCN: 这就是我昨天看见的那个人。
senses.why: Identity is stronger than similarity: it is one thing, not two.
senses.whyCN: 同一性强于相似性：它是同一个而不是两个。

senses.title: Unchanged
senses.definition: staying in the same condition as before
senses.definitionCN: 保持与以前相同的状况
senses.example: The town looks the same after ten years.
senses.exampleCN: 十年过去，这个镇子看上去依旧。
senses.why: The idea of no difference extends from things to time.
senses.whyCN: 「没有差别」从事物延伸到时间。

intro.en: Same comes from Old Norse samr, which replaced an older English word.
intro.cn: same 来自古诺尔斯语 samr，取代了更早的英语词。

items.en: A shared root means together or alike.
items.cn: 共同的词根意为「一起」或「相似」。

items.en: Samr means same or together.
items.cn: samr 意为相同的或一起的。

items.en: The native word ilca covers the meaning.
items.cn: 本族词 ilca 承担这一含义。

items.en: Same enters English from Norse influence.
items.cn: 受诺尔斯语影响，same 进入英语。

items.en: The same as becomes a fixed comparison.
items.cn: the same as 成为固定比较结构。

note.en: Same means not different; some means an unspecified amount.
note.cn: same 是「相同」，some 是「一些」。

entries.definition: the same in size or value

normalIntro.en: Same often appears with the: the same as, the same time.
normalIntro.cn: same 常与 the 连用：the same as、the same time。

normal.en: We are in the same class.
Her answer was the same as mine.
They left at the same time.
He said the same thing twice.
normal.cn: 他把同一件事说了两遍。

normal.en: Thanks, same to you.

abstract.en: Picture two cups made from one mould.
abstract.cn: 想象两个用同一模具做出的杯子。

abstract.en: Imagine a photo printed twice without change.
abstract.cn: 想象一张照片原样印了两份。

abstract.en: Think of a clock still showing the old time.
abstract.cn: 想象时钟仍停在原来的时间。

examples.en: Do you two take the same bus?
examples.cn: 你们俩坐同一路公交车吗？

examples.en: The result was the same as last year.
examples.cn: 结果和去年一样。

examples.en: All the same, I think we should try.
examples.cn: 尽管如此，我认为我们应该试一试。

dict_mnemonic.note: 搭配记忆 · 定冠词 the
dict_mnemonic.text: same 几乎总与 the 连用，记住 the same as（与…相同）和 at the same time（同时）。

root: same 源自古诺尔斯语 samr，与「一起、相同」的日耳曼词根有关，后取代本族词 ilca。

sensesIntro.en: Same means alike, the very one, or unchanged over time.
sensesIntro.cn: same 表示相同、同一，或随时间保持不变。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two things with no visible difference.
core.cn: 核心意象：看不出差别的两样东西。

branches.en: The base sense is equality between things.
branches.cn: 基础义是事物之间的相等。

branches.en: Identity means it is one thing, not two.
branches.cn: 同一性意味着是同一个而非两个。

branches.en: No difference extends across time.
branches.cn: 「无差别」延伸到时间维度。

branches.en: Alike things may or may not be the same one.
branches.cn: 相像的事物未必是同一个。

branches.en: The same person can stay unchanged for years.
branches.cn: 同一个人可以多年保持不变。

intro.en: Same rarely takes prefixes but forms a few common compounds.
intro.cn: same 很少加前缀，但能构成一些常见复合词。

latinIntro.en: Same has no Latin root; its history is Germanic and Norse.
latinIntro.cn: same 没有拉丁词根，其历史属于日耳曼语与诺尔斯语。

items.example: The sameness of the houses bored her.
items.exampleCN: 千篇一律的房子让她厌倦。
这项法律涵盖同性伴侣。

items.example: It rained, but we went all the same.
items.exampleCN: 下雨了，但我们还是去了。

items.example: My bag is the same as yours.

definition_zh: 样本；样品；试样；抽样；品尝
definition_en: a small part that shows what the whole is like; a specimen taken for testing; to take or try a small part of something
core_image: 从一整批货中取出一小份，用来代表全部
scene: 医生取了血液样本做检查。The doctor took a blood sample for testing.
sceneCN: 这里 sample 是「样本、试样」（第 2 个义项）；句意：医生取了血液样本做检查。

senses.title: A small representative part
senses.definition: a small part of something that shows what the whole is like
senses.definitionCN: 能代表整体状况的一小部分
senses.example: The shop gives free samples of the tea.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店免费提供茶叶样品。
senses.why: The core sense is a part standing for the whole.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是用部分代表整体。

senses.title: A specimen for testing
senses.definition: a small amount of a substance taken for scientific testing
senses.definitionCN: 为科学检测而取的一小份物质
senses.example: The lab analysed the water sample.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室分析了水样。
senses.why: The representative part is taken specifically for analysis.
senses.whyCN: 代表性的一小份被专门取出用于分析。

senses.title: To take or try a part
senses.definition: to take a small part of something, or to try a little of it
senses.definitionCN: 取一小部分，或少量尝试
senses.example: You can sample three dishes at the buffet.
senses.exampleCN: 自助餐上你可以品尝三道菜。
senses.why: The verb turns the small part into an action.
senses.whyCN: 动词义把「取一小份」变成动作。

intro.en: Sample comes from Old French essample, from Latin exemplum.
intro.cn: sample 来自古法语 essample，源头是拉丁语 exemplum。

items.en: Exemplum means a copy or example.
items.cn: exemplum 意为副本或范例。

items.en: Essample carries the sense of a model.
items.cn: essample 带有「范本」之义。

items.en: The first syllable drops, giving sample.
items.cn: 首音节脱落，形成 sample。

items.en: Sample names goods shown to buyers.
items.cn: 早期现代英语中 sample 指给买家的货样。

items.en: Science adopts sample for tested specimens.
items.cn: 科学领域用 sample 指待检试样。

note.en: A sample represents a whole; a simple thing is easy to understand.
note.cn: sample 是代表整体的样本，simple 则是简单的。

entries.definition: a comparison using like or as
a thing that shows a general rule
a small copy or a typical pattern

normalIntro.en: A sample is a small piece that speaks for the whole.
normalIntro.cn: sample 是代表整体的那一小份。

normal.en: They handed out samples at the supermarket.
The nurse took a blood sample.
We sampled the local food.
A random sample reduces bias.
The sample size was too small.

abstract.en: Picture one spoonful taken from a large pot.
abstract.cn: 想象从一大锅里舀出一勺。

abstract.en: Imagine a fabric swatch showing the whole cloth.
abstract.cn: 想象一块布样代表整匹布。

abstract.en: Think of a taste as a tiny preview of a meal.
abstract.cn: 把一口品尝想成整顿饭的微缩预览。

examples.en: Please send us a sample of the fabric.
examples.cn: 请给我们寄一份布料样品。

examples.en: The survey used a sample of one thousand adults.
examples.cn: 这项调查抽取了一千名成年人作为样本。

examples.en: Visitors can sample local cheeses.
examples.cn: 游客可以品尝当地奶酪。

dict_mnemonic.note: 词源记忆 · 拉丁词根
dict_mnemonic.text: sample 是 example 的姊妹词，都源于拉丁语 exemplum（范例），记住「取一份作范例」。

root: sample 经由古法语 essample 来自拉丁语 exemplum（范例、样本），首音节脱落形成现代拼写。

sensesIntro.en: Sample is a representative part, a tested specimen, or the act of trying a small amount.
sensesIntro.cn: sample 指代表性样本、检测用试样，或少量尝试的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one small part standing for the whole.
core.cn: 核心意象：以一小部分代表整体。

branches.en: The base sense is a part that represents the whole.
branches.cn: 基础义是代表整体的一部分。

branches.en: Science takes a specimen for analysis.
branches.cn: 科学取试样进行分析。

branches.en: The verb turns sampling into an action.
branches.cn: 动词义把取样变成动作。

branches.en: Shops let buyers sample what they sell.
branches.cn: 商店让买家试用所售之物。

branches.en: Testing and tasting both use a small part.
branches.cn: 检测与品尝都只取一小部分。

intro.en: Sample forms a compact family around taking or showing a small part.
intro.cn: sample 围绕「取一小份或展示一小份」形成紧凑词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin exemplum and its relatives lie behind sample and example.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exemplum 及其同族词是 sample 与 example 的源头。

items.meaning: a small part or to try one

items.exampleCN: 实验室收到了三个样本。

items.meaning: a person or device that samples
items.example: The air sampler ran all night.
We need to resample the soil.
items.exampleCN: 我们需要重新采集土壤样本。

items.meaning: a sample drawn from a sample
items.example: They drew a subsample for review.
items.exampleCN: 他们抽取子样本进行复核。

items.meaning: a survey of a selected group
items.example: The sample survey covered five cities.
items.exampleCN: 这项抽样调查覆盖了五个城市。

latinEntries.example: Exemplum is the source of sample.
latinEntries.exampleCN: exemplum 是 sample 的源头。
exemplaris 是 exemplary 的前身。

definition_zh: 批准；认可；制裁；批准（动词）
definition_en: official approval or permission; a penalty imposed to force obedience; to approve or authorize officially
core_image: 一份盖了官印的文件，既给出许可也带有强制力
scene: 政府批准了这项新计划。The government sanctioned the new plan.
sceneCN: 这里 sanction 是「批准」（第 3 个义项）；句意：政府批准了这项新计划。

senses.title: Official approval
senses.definition: official permission or approval for an action
senses.definitionCN: 对某项行动的官方许可或认可
senses.example: The plan needs the sanction of the council.
senses.exampleCN: 这项计划需要议会批准。
senses.why: The core sense is the authority that makes an act valid.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是使行为有效的权威认可。

senses.title: A penalty
senses.definition: a punishment imposed, often by one country on another, to force obedience
senses.definitionCN: 常指一国对另一国施加、迫使其服从的惩罚措施
senses.example: The country faces tough economic sanctions.
senses.exampleCN: 该国面临严厉的经济制裁。
senses.why: Authority can also punish those who break the rule.
senses.whyCN: 权威也能惩罚违反规则者。

senses.title: To approve officially
senses.definition: to give official approval or permission for something
senses.definitionCN: 对某事给予官方批准或许可
senses.example: The board sanctioned the budget.
senses.exampleCN: 董事会批准了预算。
senses.why: The verb applies the approval sense to an object.
senses.whyCN: 动词义把「批准」这一义项用于具体对象。

intro.en: Sanction comes from Latin sanctio, a decree, from sancire, to make sacred or ratify.
intro.cn: sanction 来自拉丁语 sanctio（法令），源头 sancire 意为使神圣或批准。

items.en: Sancire means to make sacred or confirm.
items.cn: sancire 意为使神圣或确认。

items.en: Sanctio names a binding decree.
items.cn: sanctio 指具有约束力的法令。

items.en: The word passes through legal French.
items.cn: 该词经由法律法语传入。

items.en: English sanction means a confirming law.
items.cn: 十七世纪英语 sanction 指确认性法律。

items.en: The word also means a punitive measure.
items.cn: 现代英语中该词也指惩罚性措施。

note.en: Sanction can mean approval or penalty; section is just a part.
note.cn: sanction 既可指批准也可指制裁，section 只是部分。

entries.definition: a small group within a larger one
a punishment for breaking a rule

normalIntro.en: Sanction is one word with two opposite faces: permission and punishment.
normalIntro.cn: sanction 一词两面：既是许可，也是惩罚。

normal.en: The minister sanctioned the export deal.
normal.cn: 部长批准了这笔出口交易。

normal.en: The UN imposed sanctions on the regime.
normal.cn: 联合国对该政权实施了制裁。

normal.en: He acted without official sanction.
normal.cn: 他未经官方批准就行动了。

normal.en: The sanctions were lifted last year.
The school sanctioned the new club.
normal.cn: 学校批准了这个新社团。

abstract.en: Picture a wax seal that both permits and punishes.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚既授权又惩戒的蜡封。

abstract.en: Imagine a gate opened by a signature.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇由签名打开的闸门。

abstract.en: Think of a heavy fine as the price of breaking rules.
abstract.cn: 把高额罚款想成违规的代价。

examples.en: The project cannot start without official sanction.
examples.cn: 这个项目未经官方批准不能启动。

examples.en: New sanctions target the country's banks.
examples.cn: 新的制裁针对该国的银行。

examples.en: The committee sanctioned the use of the hall.
examples.cn: 委员会批准使用大厅。

dict_mnemonic.note: 词源记忆 · 拉丁词根
dict_mnemonic.text: sanction 源于拉丁语 sancire（使神圣、批准），同族词有 sacred 与 saint，记住「由权威定下并强制执行」。

root: sanction 源自拉丁语 sanctio（法令），来自 sancire（使神圣、批准），与 saint、sacred 同族。

sensesIntro.en: Sanction means official approval, a punitive measure, or to approve officially.
sensesIntro.cn: sanction 指官方批准、惩罚性制裁，或正式批准某事的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an official seal that both permits and punishes.
core.cn: 核心意象：一枚既授权又惩戒的官印。

branches.en: The base sense is official approval.
branches.cn: 基础义是官方批准。

branches.en: The same authority imposes penalties.
branches.cn: 同一权威施加惩罚。

branches.en: The verb turns approval into an action.
branches.cn: 动词义把批准变成动作。

branches.en: Approval and authorizing describe one official act.
branches.cn: 批准与授权描述同一个官方行为。

branches.en: Powers that sanction deals can also sanction states.
branches.cn: 能批准交易的力量也能制裁国家。

intro.en: Sanction belongs to the sanct- family of words about what is sacred or binding.
intro.cn: sanction 属于 sanct- 词族，表示神圣或有约束力的事物。

latinIntro.en: Latin sancire, sanctio, and sanctus form the root family of sanction.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sancire、sanctio 与 sanctus 构成 sanction 的词根家族。

items.example: They gave their sanction to the plan.

items.meaning: approved or subjected to a penalty
items.exampleCN: 这次罢工获得官方批准。

items.meaning: the act of approving or penalizing
items.exampleCN: 批准此类出口颇具争议。
他们举行了一次未经批准的会议。

items.example: They defended the sanctity of life.
items.exampleCN: 他们捍卫生命的神圣性。

items.example: The birds found sanctuary in the woods.
items.exampleCN: 鸟儿在树林里找到了庇护。

items.example: The ritual was meant to sanctify the ground.
items.exampleCN: 这个仪式意在使土地神圣。

latinEntries.example: Sancire is the root of sanction.
latinEntries.exampleCN: sancire 是 sanction 的词根。
sanctus 是 saint 的前身。

definition_zh: 沙；沙子；沙滩；用砂打磨
definition_en: tiny loose grains of worn rock; an area of this material, especially a beach; to smooth or polish with sand or sandpaper
core_image: 无数细小石粒从指缝间流下
scene: 孩子们在沙滩上玩沙子。The children played in the sand on the beach.
sceneCN: 这里 sand 是「沙、沙子」（第 1 个义项）；句意：孩子们在沙滩上玩沙子。

collocations.phrase: bury one's head in the sand

senses.title: Loose grains
senses.definition: tiny loose grains formed from worn rock
senses.definitionCN: 由风化岩石形成的细小松散颗粒
senses.example: The wind blew sand into my eyes.
senses.exampleCN: 风把沙子吹进了我的眼睛。
senses.why: The base sense is the material itself.
senses.whyCN: 基础义就是这种物质本身。

senses.title: A sandy shore
senses.definition: a large area covered with sand, especially beside the sea
senses.definitionCN: 大片覆沙之地，尤指海边
senses.example: We walked for miles along the sands.
senses.exampleCN: 我们沿着沙滩走了好几英里。
senses.why: The material names the place it covers.
senses.whyCN: 这种物质用它覆盖的地方来命名。

senses.title: To smooth with sand
senses.definition: to smooth or polish a surface with sand or sandpaper
senses.definitionCN: 用砂或砂纸使表面光滑
senses.example: He sanded the table before painting it.
senses.exampleCN: 他刷漆前把桌子打磨了一遍。
senses.why: The verb uses the gritty material as a tool.
senses.whyCN: 动词义把这种颗粒材料当作工具。

intro.en: Sand comes from Old English sand, a word shared across Germanic languages.
intro.cn: sand 源自古英语 sand，是日耳曼语族共有的词。

items.en: A common root names loose ground.
items.cn: 共同的词根指松散的地面。

items.en: Sand names the grains and the shore.
items.cn: sand 指沙粒与沙岸。

items.en: Arena means sand and gives English arena.
items.cn: 拉丁语 arena 意为沙，并演变为英语 arena。

items.en: The plural sands names wide beaches.
items.cn: 中古英语复数 sands 指广阔沙滩。

items.en: The verb develops with sandpaper.
items.cn: 随着砂纸的出现，动词义逐渐形成。

note.en: Sand is fine grains; send means to make something go.
note.cn: sand 是细沙，send 则是寄送。

entries.definition: to cause something to go somewhere

normalIntro.en: Sand is the fine material that makes beaches and dunes.
normalIntro.cn: sand 是构成沙滩与沙丘的细小物质。

normal.en: Sand got into my shoes.
The children built a sand castle.
Camels cross the desert sands.
He sanded the wood until it was smooth.
Do not bury your head in the sand.

abstract.en: Picture a handful of grains slipping through your fingers.
abstract.cn: 想象一把细沙从指缝流走。

abstract.en: Imagine waves smoothing a wide beach.
abstract.cn: 想象海浪抚平宽阔的沙滩。

abstract.en: Think of paper rough with tiny sharp grains.
abstract.cn: 想象布满细小尖颗粒的粗糙纸张。

examples.en: The path was covered with fine sand.
examples.cn: 小路上铺着细沙。

examples.en: We sat on the warm sand and watched the sea.
examples.cn: 我们坐在温暖的沙滩上看海。

examples.en: She sanded the old door before painting it.
examples.cn: 她在刷漆前把旧门打磨了一遍。

dict_mnemonic.note: 词源记忆 · 拉丁同义词
dict_mnemonic.text: sand 是日耳曼本族词，而拉丁语 arena（沙）进入了英语，成为竞技场 arena 的来源。

root: sand 源自古英语 sand，属日耳曼语族；拉丁语中表示沙的 arena 则演变为英语 arena。

sensesIntro.en: Sand is the fine grains, a sandy shore, or the act of smoothing with sand.
sensesIntro.cn: sand 指细沙、沙滩沙地，或用砂打磨的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: countless tiny grains slipping through the fingers.
core.cn: 核心意象：无数细粒从指间流走。

branches.en: The base sense is the loose material.
branches.cn: 基础义是松散的沙粒。

branches.en: The material names the shore it covers.
branches.cn: 这种物质命名了它覆盖的沙岸。

branches.en: The verb uses grit to smooth a surface.
branches.cn: 动词义用砂粒磨平表面。

branches.en: Beaches are simply wide fields of sand.
branches.cn: 沙滩不过是广阔的沙地。

branches.en: The same grains that cling to skin can polish wood.
branches.cn: 沾在皮肤上的沙粒也能打磨木头。

intro.en: Sand builds a small family of compounds about sandy places and smoothing.
intro.cn: sand 构成一小组关于沙地与打磨的复合词。

latinIntro.en: Latin arena and harena mean sand and lie behind English arena.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 arena 与 harena 意为沙，是英语 arena 的源头。

items.meaning: fine grains or to smooth with them

items.example: They walked along a sandy path.

items.exampleCN: 打磨过的地板摸起来很光滑。

items.meaning: the act of smoothing with grit

definition_zh: 满意；满足；履行；补偿
definition_en: a feeling of pleasure when a need or hope is met; the fulfilment of a demand or obligation; compensation for a wrong

forms.label: 复数（指具体的满足或补偿）

senses.title: Contentment
senses.definition: a feeling of pleasure when a need or hope is met
senses.definitionCN: 需要或希望得到满足时的愉快感受
senses.example: She smiled with satisfaction.
senses.exampleCN: 她满意地笑了。
senses.why: The core sense is the good feeling of having enough.

senses.title: Fulfilment of a claim

senses.why: The feeling of enough extends to settling what is owed.

senses.title: Compensation

senses.exampleCN: 他要求为受辱获得补偿。
senses.why: An old legal sense treats a wrong as a debt to be paid.

intro.en: Satisfaction comes from Latin satisfactio, from satis enough and facere to make.
intro.cn: satisfaction 来自拉丁语 satisfactio，由 satis（足够）与 facere（做）构成。

items.en: Satis means enough.
items.cn: satis 意为足够。

items.en: Facere means to make or do.
items.cn: facere 意为做或制造。

items.en: Satisfactio means making amends.
items.cn: satisfactio 意为作出补偿。

items.en: The word enters French legal use.
items.cn: 该词进入法语法律用语。

items.en: It names both contentment and compensation.
items.cn: 现代英语中它兼指满意与补偿。

note.en: Satisfaction is the feeling of enough; saturation means being full to the limit.
note.cn: satisfaction 是满足感，saturation 则是达到饱和。

entries.definition: the state of being completely full
a feeling of not being pleased
quiet happiness with what one has
the achievement of a need or aim

normalIntro.en: Satisfaction is what you feel when something is finally enough.
normalIntro.cn: satisfaction 就是事情终于「足够」时的感受。

normal.en: She looked at the finished work with satisfaction.
normal.cn: 她满意地看着完成的作品。

normal.en: Customer satisfaction has risen this year.
normal.cn: 今年顾客满意度上升了。

normal.en: The matter was settled to everyone's satisfaction.
normal.cn: 这件事以人人满意的方式解决了。

normal.en: He gets great satisfaction from teaching.
normal.cn: 他从教学中获得极大满足。

normal.en: The court demanded satisfaction of the debt.
normal.cn: 法院要求清偿这笔债务。

abstract.en: Picture an empty cup filled to the brim.
abstract.cn: 想象一个空杯被倒到杯沿。

abstract.en: Imagine a debt crossed out at last.
abstract.cn: 想象一笔债务终于被划掉。

abstract.en: Think of a wrong balanced by a fair payment.
abstract.cn: 把过错想成由公平偿付来平衡。

examples.en: He nodded in satisfaction at the result.
examples.cn: 他对结果满意地点了点头。

examples.en: The workers expressed satisfaction with the new rules.
examples.cn: 工人们对新规定表示满意。

examples.en: The injured party sought satisfaction in court.
examples.cn: 受害方在法庭上寻求补偿。

dict_mnemonic.text: satis（足够）+ factio（做）= satisfaction，把该做的做到足够，就有了「满足」。

definition_zh: 令人满意的；符合要求的；有说服力的
definition_en: good enough to be acceptable; meeting a required standard; convincing enough to remove doubt
core_image: 一张检查表上的每个勾都打好了，可以放心通过
scene: 酒店的服务令人满意。The hotel's service is satisfactory.
sceneCN: 这里 satisfactory 是「令人满意的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：酒店的服务令人满意。

pos.zh: 有说服力的；令人信服的

senses.title: Good enough
senses.definition: good enough to be accepted, though not excellent
senses.definitionCN: 虽然不算出色，但足够好而可以接受
senses.example: The test results were satisfactory.
senses.exampleCN: 测试结果令人满意。
senses.why: The base sense is reaching an acceptable level.
senses.whyCN: 基础义是达到可接受的水平。

senses.title: Meeting a standard
senses.definition: meeting a required rule or standard
senses.definitionCN: 达到规定的规则或标准
senses.example: The building passed a satisfactory safety check.
senses.exampleCN: 这栋楼通过了符合要求的安全检查。
senses.why: Acceptable quality is defined by a standard or rule.
senses.whyCN: 可接受的质量由标准或规则来界定。

senses.title: Convincing
senses.titleCN: 有说服力的；令人信服的
senses.definition: convincing enough to remove doubt or objection
senses.definitionCN: 足以消除疑问或异议的
senses.example: He gave a satisfactory explanation for the delay.
senses.exampleCN: 他对延误给出了令人信服的解释。
senses.why: An answer is satisfactory when it settles the question.
senses.whyCN: 当答案能了结疑问时，它就是令人满意的。

intro.en: Satisfactory comes from Latin satisfacere, to satisfy, with the ending -ory.

items.en: Satis means enough.
items.cn: satis 意为足够。

items.en: Facere means to make or do.

items.en: Satisfacere means to satisfy.
items.cn: satisfacere 意为使满足。

items.en: Satisfactory means good enough to accept.
items.cn: 现代英语中 satisfactory 意为好到可以接受。

note.cn: satisfactory 描述事物，satisfied 描述人的感受。

entries.definition: pleased because a need is met

normalIntro.en: Satisfactory means good enough, not necessarily excellent.
normalIntro.cn: satisfactory 意为够好，不一定出色。

normal.en: The repair work was satisfactory.
We need a satisfactory explanation.
normal.cn: 我们需要一个令人信服的解释。

normal.en: Her progress this term is satisfactory.
normal.cn: 她这学期的进步令人满意。

normal.en: The car is in satisfactory condition.
The answer was not satisfactory to the judge.
normal.cn: 这个答复未能让法官信服。

abstract.en: Picture a checklist with every box ticked.
abstract.cn: 想象一张所有方框都打勾的检查表。

abstract.en: Imagine a bridge passing its safety test.
abstract.cn: 想象一座通过安全测试的桥。

abstract.en: Think of a door that closes every doubt.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇关掉所有疑问的门。

examples.en: The quality of the goods was satisfactory.
examples.cn: 货物质量令人满意。

examples.en: They reached a satisfactory agreement.
examples.cn: 他们达成了令人满意的协议。

examples.en: The student's attendance was satisfactory.
examples.cn: 这名学生的出勤情况符合要求。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a checklist completed well enough to pass.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张完成到足以通过的检查表。

branches.en: The base sense is reaching an acceptable level.
branches.cn: 基础义是达到可接受的水平。

branches.en: A standard defines what is acceptable.
branches.cn: 标准界定了何为可接受。

branches.en: A convincing answer settles the doubt.
branches.cn: 有说服力的答案消除疑问。

branches.en: Good enough often means meeting the rule.
branches.cn: 「够好」常常意味着符合规定。

branches.en: Both senses leave nothing more to demand.
branches.cn: 两个义项都表示再无可求。

definition_zh: 使满意；满足；符合；使信服
definition_en: to make someone pleased or content; to fulfil a need or desire; to meet a requirement; to convince someone
core_image: 把对方需要的东西刚好给足
scene: 优质服务能满足顾客。Good service can satisfy customers.
sceneCN: 这里 satisfy 是「使满意」（第 1 个义项）；句意：优质服务能满足顾客。

senses.title: To please someone
senses.definition: to make someone feel pleased or content
senses.definitionCN: 使某人感到愉快或满足
senses.example: The gift satisfied the child.
senses.exampleCN: 这份礼物让这个孩子很满意。
senses.why: The base sense is giving someone enough to be happy.
senses.whyCN: 基础义是给对方足够的东西使其高兴。

senses.title: To fulfil a need
senses.definition: to provide enough to meet a need, desire, or appetite
senses.definitionCN: 提供足以满足需要、欲望或胃口的东西
senses.example: A snack will satisfy your hunger.
senses.exampleCN: 一份点心就能让你不饿。
senses.why: A need is like an empty space that must be filled.
senses.whyCN: 需要就像一个必须被填满的空缺。

senses.title: To meet a requirement
senses.definition: to meet a rule, condition, or standard
senses.definitionCN: 达到规则、条件或标准
senses.example: The team must satisfy the entry rules.
senses.exampleCN: 这支队伍必须符合参赛规则。
senses.why: The idea of enough applies to formal conditions.
senses.whyCN: 「足够」的观念适用于正式条件。

senses.title: To convince
senses.definition: to give someone enough proof to remove doubt
senses.definitionCN: 提供足以消除疑问的证据
senses.example: The evidence satisfied the jury.
senses.exampleCN: 证据使陪审团信服了。
senses.why: Proof fills the space of doubt until nothing is left to question.
senses.whyCN: 证据填满疑问的空间，直到无可质疑。

dict_mnemonic.note: 词源记忆 · 拉丁组合
dict_mnemonic.text: satis（足够）+ fy（使…）= satisfy（使足够、使满足），同族词还有 satisfaction 与 satisfactory。

root: satisfy 源自拉丁语 satisfacere，由 satis（足够）与 facere（做）构成，意为「做到足够」。

sensesIntro.en: Satisfy means to please, fulfil a need, meet a standard, or convince.
sensesIntro.cn: satisfy 意为使满意、满足需要、符合标准，或使信服。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: giving exactly enough to fill a need.
core.cn: 核心意象：给出恰好的量来填满需要。

branches.en: The base sense is making someone pleased.
branches.cn: 基础义是使某人高兴。

branches.en: A need is an empty space to fill.
branches.cn: 需要是一个待填满的空缺。

branches.en: Rules define what counts as enough.
branches.cn: 规则界定何为足够。

branches.en: Proof fills the space of doubt.
branches.cn: 证据填满疑问的空间。

branches.en: Pleasing someone often means meeting their need.
branches.cn: 让人满意常常意味着满足其需要。

intro.en: Satisfy is the verb at the centre of the satisf- family.
intro.cn: satisfy 是 satisf- 词族的核心动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin satis and facere combine into satisfacere, the source of satisfy.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 satis 与 facere 组合成 satisfacere，即 satisfy 的源头。

items.meaning: to give enough and make content

items.exampleCN: 这个计划符合每个条件。

items.meaning: pleased or having met a need
items.example: We are satisfied with the answer.

items.exampleCN: 这是一次令人满足的经历。
许多需求仍未得到满足。

latinEntries.example: Satis is the first element of satisfy.
latinEntries.exampleCN: satis 是 satisfy 的第一个成分。
facere 在英语动词中变成 -fy。

latinEntries.example: Satisfacere is the direct source of satisfy.
latinEntries.exampleCN: satisfacere 是 satisfy 的直接源头。
satisfactus 是 satisfied 的前身。
